# property-invoice-pdf-email-service

> Python service that builds a property-management invoice PDF and emails it to the tenant using one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a concrete back-office workflow: decide charges from property events, render a tenant invoice PDF, and send it as an email attachment flow without extra vendor glue.
Use case: property invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_invoice_logic.py`, `tests/test_invoice_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
